text:
sara-docs: Quick sync — I'm revamping the token-window troubleshooting page (context limits + fallback behavior). Planning to add migration notes for SDKs and short code snippets. Will open a PR in ~30m.

anna-docs: :+1: Nice. Can we add a short 'when you hit 429s with long contexts' checklist? Recommend: trim prompt, enable prefix caching, or fallback to shorter model. Keep it actionable.

sara-docs: Yep. Also want to show a tiny example of trimming the prompt client-side and one for streaming fallback. Need the exact SDK method names for current releases.

manny-eng: I can add JS + Python snippets. Note: JS SDK now uses `client.responses.stream()`; Python uses `client.generate_stream()`.

manny-eng: JS example:
```js
const stream = await client.responses.stream({
  model: 'redwood-13b',
  input: trimPrompt(longPrompt, 8192)
});
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk);
```

manny-eng: Python example:
```py
stream = client.generate_stream(model='redwood-13b', input=trim_prompt(long_prompt, 8192))
for part in stream:
    print(part.text)
```

phil-ml: Add a short explanation about KV/prefix caching — on Dedicated, prefix caching prevents repeated KV loads for long contexts. Also add recommended fallback routing: smaller model variant (13B -> 7B quantized) when token-window evictions spike.

sara-docs: Good call. We should include a diagnostic query (what to look for in Console) and a rollout snippet for automatic fallback policy.

manny-eng: Draft rollout YAML (will refine in PR):
```yaml
fallbacks:
  - when: token_evictions > 0.05
    action: route_to_model
    target: redwood-7b-quant
    cooldown: 10m
```

deploy-bot: docslint: broken link detected -> was /guides/context-limit -> should be /guides/context-limits.

sara-docs: Thanks deploy-bot — will fix anchors and update internal links.

phil-ml: One more: clarify 'timeout' vs 'client context limit'. Example error payloads would help.

manny-eng: sample errors to paste: 
- `error: context_length_exceeded, code: 413, message: "context length exceeds model window"`
- `status: 429, detail: "rate limit (token throughput) exceeded; consider backoff"`
- `warning: kv_evicted_count: 12`

anna-docs: Can you add a tiny migration subsection for older SDKs (pre-2025) that used `complete()` vs the current streaming methods? People still run older pinned versions.

sara-docs: Will add a 'pinned SDKs' note. Targeting merge today EOD; need reviewers. @anna-docs can you do editorial pass after CI? @manny-eng can you open the PR with the snippets?

manny-eng: On it — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345. Includes JS + Python snippets and the YAML.

anna-docs: Reviewing now — left two inline suggestions about phrasing and the broken anchor.

sara-docs: Thanks all. I'll address Anna's suggestions and push fix for the link. If CI green, I'll merge. :tada: 

devex-bot: reminder: docs style check queued. Run `make docs-lint` locally to catch formatting errors.

sara-docs: Done. Running lint now. Ping if anything else pops up.

manny-eng: FYI — added a short note about detecting token-window problems from logs: grep for `context_length_exceeded` and watch for 5xx/429 spikes.

phil-ml: Looks good. Add a single-line note about cost tradeoffs when routing to larger token windows vs using prefix caching.

sara-docs: Will do. Thanks everyone!
